title: 第22章 夜游第23章 投注
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 在观尘阁的庭院中，众人重新聚首。
赵归涯已经换了一身更为休闲的装束，面具戴在了脸上，显得轻松自在。
风翼则趴在他的肩头，懒洋洋地打着哈欠。
赵归涯给每人发了一个的储物戒。
“里面有几身休闲装束，还有些散碎的灵石灵币。”
众人接过储物戒，纷纷用神识探查里面的物品。
柳清漪第一个惊呼出声：“哇！
这些衣服好漂亮！”
她从储物戒中取出一件淡青色的流仙裙，裙摆上绣着细碎的星光，在阳光下微微闪烁。
欧阳叙白也掏出一套深蓝色的劲装，衣领袖口绣着暗纹，低调又不失华贵：“未来，大手笔啊！”
叶知秋和封无痕对视一眼，各自取出一套适合长辈穿的法袍，质地轻盈，却隐隐透着高阶法器的灵韵。
楚安芷的储物戒里则是一套月白色的修身长袍，袖口和衣领处绣着银色的云纹，腰间配有一条淡青色的束带，整体素雅却不失仙气。
“小未，这些衣服……”
楚安芷有些迟疑，“不会又是你自己炼制的吧？”
赵归涯点头“是啊，不过都是几年前的存货，你们先将就着穿，到时候去欲宗给你们搞些好的。”
说着还一脸嫌弃的摇了摇头。
众人：你那嫌弃都快从面具底下溢出来了喂。
风翼在他肩头翻了个身：“主人，你的嫌弃都从眼睛和语气里溢出来了。”
“小翼！”
赵归涯伸手戳了戳小穷奇的脑袋，“就你话多。”
众人纷纷回去屋换了个衣服。
不一会儿，众人换好新衣重新聚集在庭院中。
阳光透过灵树的枝叶洒落，在崭新的衣袍上投下斑驳的光影。
柳清晏一身墨色劲装，衣襟处暗绣着银色的符文，整个人显得沉稳内敛。
他活动了下手臂，惊讶道：“这衣服竟然能自动调节大小？”
“当然啦！”
风翼骄傲地昂起小脑袋，“主人做的衣服都有这个功能！”
柳清漪转了个圈，淡青色的流仙裙随着她的动作轻轻飘动，宛如山间精灵。
她兴奋地转了个圈：“小未，这裙子好舒服！
感觉灵力运转都顺畅了不少！”
赵归涯正倚在石桌边喝茶，闻言抬头：“裙摆上的星砂是用‘流光石’磨的，能自动吸收天地灵气。”
content_en:
In the courtyard of Guanchen Pavilion, everyone reunited.
Zhao Guiya had changed into a more casual outfit, with the mask on his face, looking relaxed and at ease.
Fengyi lay on his shoulder, yawning lazily.
Zhao Guiya gave each person a storage ring.
"There are a few casual outfits inside, as well as some scattered spiritual stones and coins."
Everyone took the storage ring and used their spiritual sense to explore the items inside.
Liu Qingyi was the first to exclaim: "Wow!
These clothes are so beautiful! "
She took out a light cyan fairy skirt from the storage ring. The hem of the skirt was embroidered with tiny stars, twinkling slightly in the sunlight.
Ouyang Xubai also took out a dark blue suit, with dark patterns embroidered on the collar, low-key yet luxurious: "The future will be big!"
Ye Zhiqiu and Feng Wuhen looked at each other, and each took out a set of robes suitable for elders. The texture was light, but it had the aura of a high-end magic weapon.
Inside Chu Anzhi's storage ring is a set of moon-white slim-fitting robes. The cuffs and collar are embroidered with silver cloud patterns, and there is a light cyan belt around the waist.
"Xiao Wei, these clothes..."
Chu Anzhi hesitated, "You didn't refine it yourself again, did you?"
Zhao Guiya nodded, "Yes, but they are all stocks from a few years ago. You just have to wear them first, and then go to Yuzong to get some good ones for you."
As he spoke, he shook his head with a look of disgust.
Everyone: Your disgust is almost leaking out from under the mask.
Feng Yi turned over on his shoulder: "Master, your disgust is spilling out of your eyes and tone."
"Tsubasa!"
Zhao Guiya reached out and poked Xiao Qiongqi's head, "You are the only one who talks a lot."
Everyone went back to the house and changed their clothes.
After a while, everyone changed into new clothes and gathered again in the courtyard.
The sun shines through the branches and leaves of the spiritual tree, casting mottled light and shadow on the brand new robe.
Liu Qingyan was dressed in dark black clothes, with silver runes secretly embroidered on the skirt. He looked calm and restrained.
He moved his arms and said in surprise: "This clothes can adjust its size automatically?"
"Of course!"
Fengyi raised his little head proudly, "All the clothes made by the master have this function!"
Liu Qingyi turned around in a circle, and her light blue fairy skirt fluttered gently with her movements, like a mountain elf.
She spun around excitedly: "Xiao Wei, this skirt is so comfortable!
I feel like my spiritual power is running much smoother! "
Zhao Guiya was leaning on the stone table drinking tea. When he heard this, he raised his head and said, "The star sand on the skirt is ground with 'liquid stone', which can automatically absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth."
